capability.summary: Publish owner-authorized encrypted group photos and announcements while preserving private overrides and independently versioned current state.

invariants.name: Personal group photos take priority; clearing restores shared content. Only current owner authority can publish, and stale sessions or revisions cannot overwrite newer state.
Publication cards and private dismissal never fabricate message unread counts, recipient delivery or public read receipts.

escalation: Run group-metadata, channel-history and group avatar browser scenarios plus applicable visual regression. Native IPC and encrypted loopback/restart/capability evidence are required; browser mocks do not certify physical peer synchronization.

capability.summary: Persist device-local capture accelerators and register opt-in global shortcuts under exact unlocked session authority.

invariants.name: Global bindings default off; shortcut choices never enter portable account preferences. Failed replacement preserves previous keys or reports degraded state.
Native shortcut events and captured pixels cannot escape a retired or locked session; window restoration retains capture authority.

escalation: Verify native packaged-app foreground/background/tray capture, OS shortcut conflicts and screen-recording permission on macOS, Windows and Linux; browser mocks do not prove native global shortcut registration.

capability.summary: Register installed sticker snapshots in the current node local cache using owner and cryptographic account admission.

invariants.name: Account mismatch and session retirement reject registration; core owns image validation and bounded candidate storage.
History exposes only core-authenticated file-message aliases as opaque IDs; protection redaction, exact file availability and owner-scoped source registration retain their authority.

escalation: Verify real native direct sticker delivery with identical installed artwork, missing or changed artwork, and an older peer; focused unit checks do not prove installed candidate behavior.

capability.summary: Observe native network cost under runtime-owned cancellation and expose local-device-only status with session-authorized temporary group attachment exceptions.

invariants.name: Unknown startup protection precedes participant producers; observers cannot retain a retired Node, and lock/replacement or mismatched cost rejects override mutations.
Network cost never leaves this device in signed group controls or remote-member projections.

escalation: Verify native iPhone/Android/USB hotspot, ordinary Wi-Fi, unavailable provider, VPN, multi-interface, sleep/wake and active transfers on each supported platform; verify the local member pause/exception control.

capability.summary: Bind sensitive settings, local-agent grants, backup publication and device linking to fresh exact-session identity and lock-revision authority.

invariants.name: Denied identity verification leaves the sensitive operation uncommitted; lock/unlock and session replacement invalidate captured proof before guarded commits.

escalation: Verify packaged OS prompts and export/link/agent cancellation on each supported platform; test hooks and browser mocks do not certify native credential release.

capability.summary: Display OS hostnames only within the same account through encrypted certified-sibling device synchronization.

invariants.name: Hostnames never enter public discovery or peer profiles; unrelated Noise peers and stale native owner/account admissions cannot read them.
Bounded source-device metadata persists encrypted, supports offline display, rejects generic writes and preserves legacy synchronization through an independent cooldown.

capability.summary: Expose only verified, independently expiring registration origins and keep participant-controlled disclosure off by default.

invariants.name: Original office and immediate introducer remain distinct; IPC silence cannot renew origin disclosure
Sharing belongs to the active participant and stale owners or missing legacy settings cannot enable it

escalation: Run encrypted multi-hop core scenarios and a native settings/profile smoke check; mocked IPC alone does not prove Windows office deployment.

capability.summary: Project shared group references and bounded display member facts under current desktop runtime authority.

invariants.name: Reference flags, owner/name/member facts and completeness are coherent; can_manage is false and core sends/mutations still require real membership.
Queued reads cannot release the retired runtime's group inventory after lock, logout or same-owner replacement.
Private group control documents cannot be listed, read, written or removed through generic document IPC; consumers use typed account group interfaces.
Previous-account archive scope is derived from verified modern authority and the current full device identity; a current account grant or invitation takes precedence.

Registered list/member reads project account role separately from executor readiness; an offline original owner preserves Owner on a nonmember sibling without inventing public membership or exposing private control payloads.

Typed account operation commands expose body-free lifecycle summaries with distinct logical operation and public event IDs; lock, logout and same-owner session replacement reject queued admission, cancellation and reads.

Registered reference metadata exposes causal reconciliation separately from account permissions and distinguishes an observed history policy from an unknown local fallback; descriptive policy observations never authorize history disclosure.

Requested Leave history cleanup and exact-operation cleanup completion are distinct; standalone deletion succeeds only after local cleanup. Owner-scoped personal-state reads expose full revision/writer/hash floor identity without private payloads or changing saved host policy JSON.

escalation: Exercise registered reference list/member IPC, queued owner and lock retirement, and actual native same-account group lists. Browser mocks do not establish account-document transport.

capability.summary: Project own-account group copy evidence under current desktop session/runtime authority and deny forged generic control writes.

invariants.name: Sibling-authored outgoing history can expose confirmed external-member counts; stale sessions and wrong accounts cannot release old runtime projections.

escalation: Verify registered IPC and actual linked-device group footer convergence.

capability.summary: Expose IDs-only startup appearance observation under exact desktop session, startup ticket and app-lock authority.

invariants.name: Pending, failed, canceled and replaced startups cannot disclose retired identity; observing early identity does not admit runtime commands.

escalation: Verify native cold startup and same-owner replacement; browser mocks alone cannot prove keystore identity or cancellation ownership.

capability.summary: Adapt account document CAS writes and exact-version reads under the current desktop session and cryptographic account.

invariants.name: Certified same-account authority, bounded versioned records and deletion tombstones preserve convergence without exposing private records to other group members

escalation: Require interrupted transfer, account replacement and old-client compatibility evidence; mocked IPC does not certify physical linked-device convergence.

capability.summary: Apply per-conversation encrypted account document patches with session authority, exact version checks and explicit source-only legacy import.

invariants.name: Idle saves submit only changed conversations; stale account/session writers cannot overwrite another device’s draft
Text and protection metadata share a version; deletion tombstones survive legacy import and unbound legacy data requires explicit kept-source attribution

escalation: Native quit/restart spot check verifies encrypted draft restoration; abrupt exits may lose edits within the idle window.

capability.summary: Adapt independent Favorites queries and durable mutations with exact session/runtime authority and explicit retained-file access.

invariants.name: Queued owner replacement and app lock deny writes and plaintext release; file access requires a live favorite reference

escalation: Run registered Favorites IPC tests for save/search/edit/remove, retained-file reads/exports and queued same-owner relogin/logout/app-lock denial. Real native webview and linked-device acceptance remain separate evidence.

capability.summary: Serve exact owner-scoped recent search and bounded read-only message context with validated reference namespaces and explicit coverage.

invariants.name: Queued or replaced owners and locked apps cannot publish search or context; malformed references never select an approximate message
Search returns at most 200 hits and 1 MiB; context returns at most 51 canonical rows and 1 MiB or an explicit unavailable result

escalation: Search/context command changes require registered IPC owner/malformed-input/lock tests. Frontend adoption also requires typed adapter parity and exact duplicate/older-context browser scenarios. Headless registered dispatch does not certify real native webview acceptance.

capability.summary: Reveal exact retained protected text and images under one-operation session and existing app-lock authentication authority.

invariants.name: Ordinary history, received events, native notification previews and file/media read/save APIs cannot expose protected content
Authenticate uses existing platform app-lock verifier without unlocking or cached grants; cancellation, session/runtime replacement, any app-lock transition, recall or expiry invalidates reveal
Protected image reveal returns bounded binary bytes only for an exact retained image reference; initial authentication policy lookup does not load image bytes
Failed file acceptance preserves the managed paste source for retry; successful durable acceptance removes the staging source

escalation: Exercise protected text/image send/reveal and lock-dismissal browser consumers. Packaged macOS system authentication success/cancellation and non-macOS account-password verification require native evidence; headless verifier futures do not certify OS prompts.
Session/authorization changes require review of app-lock, integrations and contact-policy admission; native startup/retirement changes require focused native evidence.

capability.summary: Authorize desktop work against the exact login generation and serialize runtime replacement with retirement.

invariants.name: Profile acceptance releases the UI before admitted network fanout completes
Nickname publication does not block observations behind stalled network work
Channel acceptance returns exact IDs before admitted network fanout finishes
Replacement and logout invalidate captured session authority
Stale startup cannot launch participant producers
Runtime replacement awaits prior runtime retirement

Startup serialization outlives canceled construction and actual blocking captures/results; retired profile handles drop before replacement admission opens. Runtime handoffs retain the original non-cryptographic host local-user label.
Stalled network producers allow observations and unrelated sends while blocking runtime retirement
Typed device-linking errors preserve the failed stage and safe diagnostics across IPC without weakening desktop admission or account adoption
Saved login requires both credential and resume metadata writes; retry uses the private canonical account login secret under current unlocked session authority

Signed account nicknames project into persisted desktop and frontend state only for the current installed session; old completed markers without a signed card repair the already-bound profile, while a pending adoption never publishes its unrelated previous local nickname across restart

Inbound DM, channel and file presentation queues before acquiring desktop-session authority; UI-thread execution revalidates the exact session and runtime without a worker/main-thread focus-query deadlock.

capability.summary: Control one session-owned integration service, persist explicit authorization deadlines and expose content-free recent local-interface activity.

invariants.name: Startup and settings serialize one listener/service owner; disable closes commit admission and retirement joins its producers
Only the marked AGENTS.md block is updated or removed; repeated toggles preserve unrelated instructions and prompts contain only public help discovery
New authorizations default to one hour; legacy persistent grants survive, and retries/restarts/scope edits preserve deadlines while renewal and extensions require fresh identity verification.
Recent activity exposes only bounded time/destination/accepted-or-retried metadata without opening a second registry writer or attributing a shared token to an AI vendor.

escalation: Native IPC/session retirement changes require the relevant platform/native checks.
IPC command names/payloads and emitted events require typed frontend API/store consumer checks and affected browser behavior; file/native side effects require focused native evidence.

capability.summary: Adapt account-scoped personal contact deletion and visibility under the exact installed runtime while preserving legacy host policy projection shape.

invariants.name: Deletion requires the caller-captured account root and permits online contacts; missing clear-history defaults to true while explicit false retains history. Presence never restores deletion; shared reopen requires a matching caller-captured root, and core-known visibility supersedes legacy local suppression without removing an erasure floor.

Account personal-state reads require exact runtime and account authority; local cleanup never removes network membership, verified identity, favorites or exports, and queued session retirement rejects destructive producers.

escalation: Contact deletion/admission changes require session-authority, persistence and native mesh acceptance evidence.
OS authentication and unlock/session lifecycle changes require focused native platform evidence.
Persisted settings and live policy application require frontend settings and native session/revision evidence.

capability.summary: Create consistent manual encrypted backups with one acknowledged reusable local recovery key, then verify and transactionally restore into a new local profile.

invariants.name: Saved keys and destination preferences remain encrypted per local user; corrupt setup is never silently replaced and acknowledgement is required before a saved-key export.
Every archive retains a fresh salt and original key compatibility; verified restoration installs its supplied key with the new local credentials.

Export reuses joined retired storage and checks both original host local-user label and canonical profile root before any temporary/archive write; equal mesh account identity never authorizes another local profile. Staged restore/enrollment close every handle and the checked SQL connection before relocation.

escalation: Crypto, archive and trust persistence changes require affected core recovery integration tests and frontend/native restore evidence.

capability.summary: Discover desktop and standard dedicated post-office endpoints from optional VPN inventories without trusting inventory identities.

invariants.name: Provider fairness and the 256-endpoint budget include both standard service ports
Core signature and independent nonce validation owns discovery authority

escalation: Discovery inventories/fixtures and routing require focused native live-network acceptance; nonignored parser tests do not execute ignored physical client tests.
Privacy IPC/public policy changes require core guarded-admission and typed frontend consumer checks.

capability.summary: Expose scoped account privacy and explicit recipient review of authenticated device account changes.

invariants.name: Viewing account binding changes mutates nothing and acceptance requires current unlocked installation authority plus the exact reviewed device and old/new account pair

escalation: On macOS run the native-window-reopen-eval example with an isolated absolute data root and --hidden. Verify physical packaged Dock and tray Open/click restoration after close-to-tray and minimization, repeated activation, locked entry and hidden autostart. Mock runtime tests do not establish native visibility or focus.

Verify registered main-window presentation IPC, queued hide/ack/fallback ordering and hidden launch. Preserve X11 placement and geometry; require actual packaged first-visible-frame evidence plus browser image/library readiness and unchanged visuals.

capability.summary: Own native placement, explicit visibility and safe one-shot initial presentation without restoring persisted visibility over launch intent.

invariants.name: Normal initial show waits for an authorized prepared renderer or bounded fault fallback; hidden launch, explicit visibility and queued retirement remain authoritative. Presentation IPC never admits account content.

escalation: Logging/privacy and diagnostics IO changes require affected integration/native evidence.

Updater/native process and release artifact changes require explicit native/release validation; verify logical About/diagnostics versions and numeric native metadata agree with the canonical target; exercise same-base Nightly replacement on each native installer and exact-source hosted signing/publication.

Build the three native updater acceptance examples on their target OS, use alternate identifiers and disposable profiles, and verify signed replacement/relaunch plus rejected tampering. SDK fixtures do not certify production GitHub discovery, login/session/draft recovery or interactive OS authorization. Windows must also execute the resource-preserving installer launch-failure regression.

Incremental updates require cargo test -p mesh-talk --example delta-artifact, authenticated catalog and bounded decoder tests, one independently signed canonical full fallback, cancellation during patch preparation, and native macOS/Windows evidence asserting actual patch route and bytes before installation/restart/session acceptance. Linux retains full AppImage behavior; fixture or fallback success never certifies native delta acceptance.

capability.summary: Discover explicit update channels and verify device-matching downloads, with version-bound signed native installation and restart when supported.

invariants.name: Stable is the default and rejects drafts and all prereleases. Nightly accepts only published canonical Nightly identities or Stable; use standard SemVer ordering for BASE-dev, BASE-nightly.RUN.ATTEMPT and tagged BASE, preserving OS/architecture and never silently downgrading.

Revalidate the exact canonical release and its channel before downloading; verify size and SHA-256 before exposing the final path. Native installation additionally requires the embedded public key and a matching signed full logical version. Channel selection never changes identity, local data or installs software.

Optional signed executable-prefix deltas reconstruct exact signed native installer bytes within local bounds; missing or unsupported transport falls back once to the independently verified original compressed payload. Cancellation and authentication/identity failures never trigger fallback or installation.

escalation: Desktop entry points/build configuration, binary-only Linux renderer, native capabilities and integration harnesses use conservative library coverage. Explicitly build changed binary/example targets, run affected integration targets and native platform/renderer/capability checks; library filters do not execute them.

capability.summary: Read ordinary public profiles and save biographies behind exact-session authority without exposing creation timestamps or proof editing.

invariants.name: Public signatures never grant private verification or trusted time
Logout and replacement invalidate profile mutation authority

escalation: Run account-profile browser interaction and native owner/lock/replacement command evidence; verify ordinary rename updates the same signed profile.

capability.summary: Observe real machine notification authorization and offer explicit recovery independently of saved account preferences.

invariants.name: Unsupported queries and failed observations are unknown, never assumed authorization
Only explicit actions may prompt or open fixed system-settings destinations

escalation: Run e2e/notification-permission.spec.ts for UI recovery and nonblocking sends. Packaged macOS and Windows authorization/revocation, system-settings navigation and actual notification delivery require native platform evidence; browser mocks and mapping tests do not certify them.

capability.summary: Transport verified encrypted recovery archives using a reusable acknowledged recovery key and remembered encrypted Google refresh grant, with bounded cancellable requests and manual backups.

invariants.name: Active Drive connections and pending work belong to the exact desktop session generation; saved refresh grants are encrypted per local user, signed-out restore remains temporary, and recovery keys never reach Google.
Only complete checksum-verified archives are offered; prior backups and existing profiles are never overwritten.

escalation: Run Google Drive browser flows and packaged desktop OAuth on macOS/Windows/Linux with a configured client. Prove cancelled transfers, revoked grants, runtime restart after snapshot and fresh-install restore; loopback HTTP tests do not certify Google consent or provider behavior.

capability.summary: Capture through the Linux Screenshot portal or an optional native X11 helper into the shared screenshot editor.

invariants.name: Portal capture takes precedence; only native X11 windows without portal screen capability can use the helper; portal cancellation and errors never trigger fallback
X11 helper output is a bounded PNG in a private temporary directory, with bounded execution and cleanup on every result

escalation: Run native Linux capture on XFCE/X11 without a Screenshot portal, including normal and hide-window capture, editor confirmation/cancel and window restoration. Also check portal cancellation and a native Wayland session; unit/helper tests alone do not certify native webview behavior.

capability.summary: Expose the owner-controlled recent history window for new channel members.

invariants.name: Only an accepted owner may change the policy; stale channel or desktop session results never replace current settings

escalation: Run channel membership browser and native IPC scenarios for owner-only settings, channel switching and desktop session retirement; mocked IPC does not certify native authorization.

capability.summary: Apply unified account login credentials only to the exact live desktop session and preserve private storage keys.

invariants.name: Explicit source selection shares account login name and password; nickname remains a separate public account profile field
Credential installation checks exact session and runtime authority at atomic commit; device-bound adoption intent permits only the selected account transition
Runtime and backup use retained node storage secrets; saved login and unlock use canonical account credentials without exposing passwords through IPC

Signed-out enrollment creates only a device identity until source proof validates; shared credentials and the verified account profile publish together through the recovery journal with login namespace and generation guards

escalation: Require source-to-target V4 native relogin, collision and stale-session evidence. Packaged native saved-login authorization must be observed separately from mocks.

capability.summary: Bound the actual native-to-WebView reception boundary with one scoped wake and one acknowledged demand page.

invariants.name: Runtime, local user, account and device authority fence every page and ACK; current state/progress use the same coalesced wake.
Notifications begin at launch high-water and coalesce a bounded live window independently of durable unread processing.

escalation: Verify actual native IPC stalls, WebView reload, storage failure, app lock and runtime/account replacement; pure gate tests do not establish packaged native memory bounds.

capability.summary: Serve bounded reaction counts for selected visible targets under the captured desktop runtime owner.

invariants.name: Account and runtime replacement reject stale query publication; selected pages preserve certified ownership without materializing author lists.
